newsitem.title: USA: Reading & Bates wins Premier contract.
newsitem.headline: Reading & Bates wins Premier contract.

text.p: Reading & Bates said on Tuesday that it had been awarded a contract worth $27.3 million for its 300 foot cantilever jackup Harvey H. Ward by Premier Oil.
The company said the drilling contract in the Far East was for one year and would start in 1998.
"Additionally, Reading & Bates expects to obtain another term contract in the near future for a sister jackup in the Far East at similar rates," the company said in a statement.
Reading & Bates said that the contract follows on from a four well programme, also with Premier. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
